title: Rust at speed — building a fast concurrent database
summary: A guest lecture Jon Gjengset gave at Two Sigma on using Rust for large, high-performance systems. It covers why Rust suits such projects, the Noria research database, a concurrent data structure used in it, and practical experience.
why: HN points to it as a detailed, captivating talk by the Noria author, including a good explanation of deduplicating data between maps using unsafe.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: gave a great talk about the system
